description: Store whose published home page (Page Builder page 'home') shows a Product List widget (PortalMapping) with at least N active products; outputs them in widget display order. Source: published CMS widget tables.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode); the resolved store must be this store

minProducts.description: Fewest active products the home page product widget must show (e.g. the number of cards the test checks). Left out: any
